mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP161 excludes package.json from protected artifact hashes because package scripts are mutable orchestration outside the LP161 runtime/data boundary.
No script definitions are read by LP160 or LP161 deterministic generators.
No git branch commands or environment variables are read.
No git commit commands or environment variables are read.
No merge commit identity is read.
Both generators use the fixed timestamp 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.
Absolute paths are used only to locate repository-relative governed inputs and are not emitted or hashed as values.
No mtime fields are read.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: current working-tree bytes of historical artifacts
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP160 compares generated objects to its own committed outputs; LP161 hashes only explicitly governed runtime/data artifacts and compares generated reports to committed outputs.
Neither generator enumerates later milestone reports.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: a report that directly or indirectly hashes itself
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: No generated report path is included in its own protected hash inventory.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: a report that hashes another report which hashes it back
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP160 and LP161 report hashes are acyclic; LP161 protected hashes are data/runtime artifacts only.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: LP161 output included in its own protected-artifact inventory
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP161 protected artifacts exclude reports/lp161 outputs.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: LP161.1 output included in LP161 inputs
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP161 does not read reports/lp1611.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: post-LP160 files included in LP160 deterministic inventory
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP160 reads the governed source snapshot and county registry only; it does not enumerate repository inventories.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: post-LP161 files included in LP161 deterministic inventory
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: LP161 reads governed destination data, category mapping, county registry, and runtime manifest only.

mutableAndCircularInputAudit.input: directory enumeration that expands when later reports are added
mutableAndCircularInputAudit.finding: Both generators use explicit path lists and do not enumerate report directories.
Emitted paths are repository-relative POSIX strings from explicit constants.
LP160 uses localeCompare for stable in-repository ASCII/FIPS/id/token values; no host locale expansion inputs are used.
Both generators serialize through sorted-key stable JSON with a trailing LF.
Generated JSON always uses LF with one trailing newline; source checksum is over governed source bytes by design.
